author: LadyLeigh
name: TwitchBridge
short: Twitch chat, commands, events, roles and account linking.
description: Custom Twitch/Discord bridge with timers, shared to-dos, counters, stream variables, ad controls, word triggers, greetings, attendance streaks, channel events, roles and verified account linking. Includes moderator controls for stream title, category/game, tags and language.
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-server Discord/Twitch identity links and timestamps, broadcaster and bot OAuth tokens, channel/role settings and integration-owned role grants. Pending verification codes and cooldowns are in memory. Supports member unlink and Red data deletion. Existing mirrored Discord chat logs have independent retention. Stores linking-panel message IDs and configuration. Identity-only member approval tokens are transient, revoked after use, and never saved. Channel-event payloads, deduplication IDs and delivery counters are held in memory only; event templates and enable settings are saved per server. Stores shared to-do text, response counters, automation settings, ad-warning receipts, and per-broadcaster Twitch IDs with streak/first-message attendance data. Linked Discord deletion and owner Twitch-forget commands remove attendance data.
